guides.favoredWhen: Garen wins the level 6 to mid-game window with short trades; Jax wins if he survives to scale or baits out the full combo.

keyTips.text: Start E and use W when he jumps in or when his stun lands. Decide which part of the trade to blunt, since the shield covers only one burst window.
keyTips.heading: Trade defense

keyTips.text: Never auto-attack into his Counter Strike. Its return damage turns your spin trade into his winning exchange.
keyTips.heading: E respect

keyTips.text: Shape every trade to disengage after your E instead of staying for his return damage. His full combo after your spin ends is where he wins.
keyTips.heading: Disengage rule

tips.text: Time Q as his stun ends so its damage lands right after, accepting the risk. The tight window punishes his E cooldown, but a mistimed Q wastes the silence.
tips.heading: Q timing

tips.text: Re-hit him before his passive regenerates. His recovery depends on quiet time, so short re-engages keep him from healing back to full.
tips.heading: Regen denial

tips.text: From level 6, take short trades before attempting an all-in. Chipping first keeps his ultimate from deciding the finish at full health.
tips.heading: Post-6 pattern

tips.text: Threaten the execute once he is low, since he must respect it. His whole late trade bends around your ult range, which opens the all-in you set up with shorts.
tips.heading: Execute threat

tips.text: Close the lane in the level 6 through mid-game window. You hold the advantage there, while he scales to match you late.
tips.heading: Timing window

tips.text: Track his scaling and end before it lands. An even lane that drags on becomes his lane, so convert the mid-game lead into objectives.
tips.heading: Closing rule

sources.author: PH45
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; no title claim) · Jax main

guides.favoredWhen: Garen wins by baiting Riposte and landing silence into ult; Fiora wins any extended trade where she holds W for his combo.

keyTips.text: Open with a faked Q to draw Riposte, then commit the real combo after her W is gone. A parried Q hands her the stun that decides the duel.
keyTips.heading: Q bait

keyTips.text: Track her vitals and move away from the marked side, using a wall to deny easy angles. Every free proc is the extended trade she wants.
keyTips.heading: Vital denial

keyTips.text: Silence before ulting, and never telegraph Q into R. Apply Q's silence right before R while varying the timing, since a predictable Q or R gets parried.
keyTips.heading: Ult setup

tips.text: Use Q to clear her Riposte slow and attack-speed debuff, then spin through it. The slow never reduces your E damage, so keep spinning once Q is back up.
tips.heading: Slowed spins

tips.text: Accept a small Q poke if minion aggro keeps the wave near your side. Conceding position for perfect health loses the wave, while a held wave denies her run-down angles.
tips.heading: Wave over health

tips.text: Cancel E early sometimes to surprise her with Q. The shortened spin breaks her parry timing and lands the silence she was holding W against.
tips.heading: E cancel

tips.text: Answer her melee commits with E instead of chasing max-range pokes. She wants you to overextend into her vitals; punish the commits she actually makes.
tips.heading: Punish commits

tips.text: Favor fights when both champions are already around half health over fresh full-health duels. The short window favors your burst combo before her sustained damage takes over.
tips.heading: Half-health fights

tips.text: Never chase her split alone even with a movement-speed rune. Account for her chase and split-push threat by answering with numbers instead of solo runs.
tips.heading: Split answer

sources.author: TTVJustSad42
sources.rankClaim: Challenger EUNE / Grandmaster EUW (self-claim, no badge) · Fiora main

guides.favoredWhen: Garen wins by owning levels 1–3, sidestepping both Q casts, and scaling an even lane; Aatrox wins if he controls waves, holds Garen tagged, and turns ganks.

keyTips.text: Sidestep the first Q laterally and leave the second Q's outer zone. Stepping forward beats some casts, and your Q carries you out of his W pull when the zone closes.
keyTips.heading: Both Q casts

keyTips.text: Own the first three levels while tracking his cooldowns. That window plus spacing is the whole early game, so press it before his range comes online.
keyTips.heading: Levels 1–3

keyTips.text: Hold Courage for his commit, never for the wave. He times poke around your W downtime, so a spent shield is his invitation to open up.
keyTips.heading: W discipline

tips.text: Expect Q on every approach to a last hit. Concede the creep whenever the trade costs more than the gold, since his aim point is your farming pattern.
tips.heading: Last-hit tax

tips.text: Use Q to leave the center of his W, not to engage. The pull zone is where his combo starts, so save the silence-break for exits.
tips.heading: Q as exit

tips.text: Take Conqueror only to build an early lead with its fighting power. When the damage will not open kills, run Stormraider's Surge and save Q to clear slows instead.
tips.heading: Setup pick

tips.text: Leave completely until Perseverance restarts. He tags you to hold your healing down, so a half-reset just invites the next Q chain.
tips.heading: Full resets

tips.text: Let an even lane stay even. You scale slightly better from parity, so stop forcing duels and let the map tilt instead.
tips.heading: Even wins

tips.text: Call the jungler only for certain kills. His Q spread turns a hesitant dive into his double kill, so bring numbers or do not come at all.
tips.heading: Gank care

sources.author: Federals1
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (self-stated 900 LP+ each season since 2018; EUW Challenger) · Garen main

keyTips.text: Play the first levels cautiously until trades turn reliable.
From level 6, shorten trades to lower the opponent, heal back on the passive, and hunt the R execute.
Peel and absorb on a tank build, or flank from fog for carries on a bruiser build.

tips.text: Hide approaches with lane brush cover when lining up an all-in.
Trade more often after a few levels or a first component lands.
Never chase ranged opponents without a flank, since zero ranged engage means getting kited.
Match the build to team need; full damage risks everything when nobody else frontlines.
Split-push without a developing fight to pull opponents while teammates siege or start plays.
Duel defenders who answer the split instead of surrendering the lane free.
At level 9, press the first maxed ability for stronger short trades and easier duels.
Set picks with Q and R alongside teammates while rotating lanes.
Read the first component fork: a tank piece holds lanes and joins fights, a bruiser piece raises duel damage.
At level 11, catch exposed opponents from brush with short burst around the second R point.
Peel for carries and eat pressure on the tank build so they keep dealing damage.
Punish an exposed target with Q and R in late fights, then peel for allies instead of diving solo.
After poke lands, retreat briefly and let the passive refill health before deciding on recall.
At level 16, hunt a safe catch with teammates near the third R point and its damage and cooldown jump.

itemization.text: Choose the durable route whenever the team lacks a frontline.
